name: Bingles' Missing Supplies

narrative.details:
As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!

Get my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, adventurer. For Gnomeregan!
narrative.objectives:
Find and return Bingles' supplies:

Bingles' Wrench, Bingles' Screwdriver, Bingles' Hammer, and Bingles' Blastencapper.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've done the movement a great service, adventurer. The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 15, 1,320 XP in all.
